status: prospective new calculations using previously inventoried public tables; not a blind analysis

dustpedia.sample: all 90 3-kpc rows; join global by exact host and 1-kpc by exact SN; preserve repeated hosts
dustpedia.outcomes: signed global-minus-local age, attenuation, colour, sSFR; 1-minus-3-kpc contrasts; host-cluster bootstrap intervals
dustpedia.predictors: age Gyr, host-population AV, logM, u-r, log sSFR; no progenitor ages or line-of-sight extinction substituted
dustpedia.distance_join: normalized SN aliases plus <=3 arcsec coordinate verification; list all conflicts and repeated distance rows
dustpedia.distance_models: released corrected magnitude versus Cepheid distance for calibrators only; free intercept, age, and age plus local AV plus global mass sensitivity; covariance from released STAT+SYS and shared-host Cepheid distance sensitivity
dustpedia.forecast: fixed age Gaussian GLS conditional power for -0.03 mag/Gyr; explicitly excludes age uncertainty and unreported host posteriors
dustpedia.holdout: leave one host out predictive mean-square error on common sample; same folds for all models

ztf.sample: 944-name public masterlist, host redshift z_gal, 0.01<=z<=0.06, public quality flags both 1, SALT quality limits, complete local/global mass and colour; no claim of exact 932/929 author selection
ztf.magnitude: -2.5 log10(x0), free intercept; compute CMB radial redshift from release heliocentric z and sky under declared dipole; retain (1+zHEL) luminosity factor
models: width+colour+redshift+soft global mass step+local colour+colour squared+width squared
ztf.noise: within-SN SALT covariance plus redshift error and 250 km/s velocity floor plus fitted independent intrinsic scatter; no unprovided shared calibration covariance
ztf.holdout: five deterministic host-coordinate-group folds; held-out normalized Gaussian log predictive score with fit uncertainty; supporting descriptive prediction diagnostic, not causal age/dust identification
ztf.controls: primary local colour term compared with mass; z>=0.02 and c<0.1 declared sensitivities
ztf.bounds: no BayeSN refit, no BBC correction, no cosmology-ready calibration claim
